title: Lazy loading and prefetching
description: Learn about Lazy loading and prefetching. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Lazy loading and prefetching** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with lazy loading and prefetching.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of lazy loading and prefetching
Learn practical applications and use cases
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them
Apply best practices in your daily work

data.text: Understanding lazy loading and prefetching is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with lazy loading and prefetching, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
